slides.label: Verse 1
slides.body:
Nkululeko ephakathi,
Ngithanda ukukubonga;
Wena wedwa ungumusa,
Ngiyakuthanda wena.

slides.label: Chorus
slides.body:
Halala, halala!
Uyingcwele uJehova;
Halala, halala!
Simakade esihle.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.body:
Lapho ngizithola lingenalutho,
Ungisiza ngamandla akho;
Lapho ngiyawa phansi,
Ungiphakamisa wena.

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.body:
Masiye emphakathini,
Simeme igama leNkosi;
Masiye emphakathini,
Sibonge uMusa wayo.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.body:
Izulu nomhlaba ziyabonga,
Izidalwa zonke ziyakhala;
Masiye emphakathini,
Simeme igama leNkosi.

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.body:
Ngiyakuthanda Jesu,
Ngoba wangisindisa;
Wangifela ephahleni,
Wangihlanza ngomusa.

slides.label: Chorus
slides.body:
Jesu, Jesu, Jesu!
Ungumusa wami;
Jesu, Jesu, Jesu!
Ngiyakuthanda wena.

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.body:
Kusasa kuyabhadala,
Izinkanyezi ziyacwila;
Siyalindela iNkosi,
Ize ibuyele khona.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.body:
Masihlale sivukile,
Masigcine izibuko zethu;
Kusasa kuyabhadala,
Simeme igama leNkosi.

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.body:
Ngiyakuthokoza,
Ngoba ungiphethe;
Ngiyakuthokoza,
Ngoba ungihlalisa.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.body:
Emini nasebusuku,
Ungumhlengi wami;
Ngiyakuthokoza,
Ngoba ungiphethe.

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.body:
Nxa ngihamba endleleni,
Ungikhanya phambili;
Ngiyakuthokoza,
Ngoba ungiphethe.
